violations.text: Raw animal foods were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods in the prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Food relocated. Guidance document provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of bio-film. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was turned off. Ice was disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/10/2026
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Pic stated scoop will either kept in water above 135 or dry. Utensil relocated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026
A small amount of old rodent droppings was observed in the storage area. Area to be cleaned. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2026

Food contact surfaces of ice machine were observed with an accumulation of bio-film. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice was disposed of. Establishment to increase frequency of sanitizing ice machine. Ice machine to be sanitized prior to getting turned on. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2024

(Chemical) was stored with food, equipment, utensils, or single service items. Chemicals must be stored to prevent the contamination of clean equipment, utensils linens, and/or single service by spacing or partitioning and locating them in an area that is not above food, equipment utensils, linens, and single service articles. Chemicals were moved. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2024
The establishment is lacking test strips for the chlorine and quaternary ammonium sanitizer. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2024

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap (Currently has air break.) A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2024
The door to the kitchen toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2024
The receptacle in the unisex toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 05/27/2024
